concept: CloudFront invalidation: refresh a cached object immediately
tests: Purging a stale object from edge caches when the TTL is long.
expected: CloudFront invalidation for /css/app.css (first 1,000 paths per month free). Triggers: "replaced the file in the origin", "24-hour TTL", "needed immediately". Long term — versioned file names.
why_not: Storage class affects S3, not the CDN cache; disabling the distribution means downtime; switching the origin to an ALB is irrelevant.
